mapper.sql: select d.delivery_id, d.delivery_no, d.order_id, d.work_id, d.buyer_id, d.seller_id, d.amount, d.license_type, d.status, d.contract_no, d.contract_sign_time, d.cert_no, d.remark, d.upload_time, d.confirm_time, d.completed_time, d.created_at, d.updated_at, o.order_no, w.title as work_title, w.cover as work_cover, ub.nick_name as buyer_name, us.nick_name as seller_name from sys_delivery d left join sys_order o on d.order_id = o.order_id left join sys_work w on d.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_user ub on d.buyer_id = ub.user_id left join sys_user us on d.seller_id = us.user_id
